title: cost-optimization: autotune batching/caching defaults + quantization profiles + unit-econ tooling
author: Ava Reynolds
description: This PR introduces an automated cost-optimization pipeline that: 1) autotunes batching and KV-caching defaults per model and workload class based on recent request traces; 2) adds a small catalog of quantization profiles and a selection heuristic to match profiles to workload sensitivity; and 3) surfaces unit-economics tooling in the Console and CLI to help teams estimate per-token cost vs latency tradeoffs. Motivation: customers repeatedly ask for safe, opinionated defaults that reduce token costs without manual tuning; platform teams want deterministic ways to recommend quantization and batching for Dedicated capacity and Private installs. Changes are backward compatible by default and behind feature flags for gradual rollout. The PR contains code changes to the autotune service, runtime config plumbing, a quant-profiles registry, and Console/CLI UX plus unit-econ report generation and E2E tests. Checklist: - [x] Autotune service implementation and unit tests - [x] Quantization profiles registry + selection heuristic - [x] Config migration and feature flag - [x] Console UI for unit-econ reports + CLI command - [x] Integration tests (canary) - [x] Documentation updates and release notes. Risk/rollback: feature flag disabled by default; safe fallback to existing defaults; migration is reversible. Related linear: ENG-2243, PM-512. This PR combines work from RFC #1182 and follow-ups in perf team.
